documents.stance_why: The page sets no default rule for coursework; it says "Each course may have its own rules and expectations regarding AI usage, set by the instructor" and "When permitted by your instructor", leaving the decision to instructors, so delegates.
documents.summary: Technology Services page introducing ChatGPT Edu at Fresno State, setting out campus-wide principles and separate guidance for faculty/staff and students. It mostly delegates AI-use decisions to course instructors while requiring citation, disclosure, verification and data protection, and it explains the CSU data-protection and governance arrangements.

notes: Three university-layer documents (ChatGPT Edu AI guidelines page, student terms, CSU student guidelines); no school, computing or course documents. Reconciled from two coders. Recurring UNCOVERED: a ban on using AI to deceive, fabricate data or manipulate information (guidelines page, student guidelines, and a variant in the student terms); the student duty to read the syllabus was folded into P04 for consistency with the terms document. The sentence 'AI tools should not replace active engagement ... or be used to complete assignments without demonstrating independent learning' was split into a P32 and a P19 unit in the guidelines page and the student guidelines. Student guidelines text is extracted one word per line with ligature characters; anchors follow it.
